name: UGC 11651 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 11651, a spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc11651-hubble
story: This massive spiral galaxy was once listed among the low surface brightness galaxies. Hubble searched it for globular clusters and turned up a high number of candidates.

claims.text: UGC 11651 is a massive spiral galaxy (type Sdm) in program GO-10550
The sample galaxies were originally cataloged as low surface brightness galaxies
UGC 11651 has a high number of globular cluster candidates
